voice-input.setupPrompt.title: Set up voice input before recording
voice-input.setupPrompt.body: Voice input is enabled. First use requires downloading and preparing local recognition models. Open the plugin details to review disk space, memory and time estimates before starting setup.
voice-input.setupPrompt.unavailableBody: Open the voice plugin details to check recognition status, preparation progress, or errors.
voice-input.setup.local: Local models will be downloaded to the machine running DSH. No Python or compiler is required.
voice-input.setup.diskValue: Allow about {gb} GB for models, runtime, and download caches
voice-input.setup.memoryValue: About {gb} GB with the model loaded; recognition may use more
voice-input.setup.timeValue: Allow roughly {min}–{max} minutes, depending on the network and machine
voice-input.setup.estimateNote: These are estimates; slow networks may take longer. Downloads are reused; idle models release memory by default.
voice-input.download.network: Cannot download {resource}: connection to the download service failed.
voice-input.download.dns: Cannot download {resource}: the download address could not be resolved.
voice-input.download.http: Cannot download {resource}: the download service returned HTTP {status}.
voice-input.download.integrity: The download of {resource} is incomplete or failed verification.
voice-input.download.storage: Cannot save {resource}: insufficient disk space or write permission.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.network: Check that the machine running DSH can reach the download source and its model download services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed, then retry.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.dns: Check DNS and proxy settings on the machine running DSH. Confirm that it can resolve the download source domain, then retry.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.timeout: Check the network or proxy connection on the machine running DSH, then retry later. Verified downloaded files are retained.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.certificate: Check the system clock, trusted certificates and proxy settings on the machine running DSH, then retry.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.http: Confirm that the download address is available and the proxy can reach the download service, or retry later.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.integrity: Retry the download. Other completed and verified files are retained.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.storage: Check available disk space and write permission for the model directory on the machine running DSH, then retry.
voice-input.downloadAdvice.unknown: Check the network, disk space and model directory permissions on the machine running DSH, then retry.
voice-input.sourceAutoHelp: Prefer the first responding source and try another if a download fails.
voice-input.sourceManualHelp: Download only from the selected source. Verified downloaded files are reused.
voice-input.preparation.unprepared: First use downloads the local recognition models.
voice-input.preparation.standby: Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer.
voice-input.preparation.cancelled: Preparation cancelled. Completed downloads are retained.
voice-input.interrupted: Recording was interrupted. Please try again.
voice-input.local: Audio is recognized on the machine running DSH. If models need downloading, that machine must be able to reach the selected source and its file services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed.
voice-input.cloud: Audio will be sent to the selected cloud service.
voice-input.conflict: Your draft changed. The transcript is preserved and can be inserted at the current cursor.
voice-input.unavailable: This browser cannot record audio. Use a browser with microphone support.
voice-input.permission: Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings.
voice-input.tooLarge: The recording exceeds the service limit. Try a shorter recording.
